units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 1:14">Targ. Prov. I, 14</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:3">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>לא שקל ידא מן כ׳</he> never took his hand out of his pocket (always prepared for charity).

Pes. 113ᵃ שרי כִּיסָיךְ וכ׳ untie thy purse, open thy sack, i.e. sell only for cash (Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). [Sabb. 67ᵃ לכ׳ לימא הכי Ar. for a bag (ulcer), v. כֵּיבָא.]—Pl. כִּיסַיָּא, כִּיסֵי.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:5:12">Y. Kidd. I, 60ᵈ</cite>, v. <cite ref="C01393"><he>גְּרַר</he></cite>.

Ab. Zar. 70ᵃ כמה כ׳ וכ׳ how many money-bags ought to be found on the street! Sabb. 147ᵃ כִּיסֵי בבלייתא pouches (a sort of cape or hood) worn by the Babylonian women; (Ar.: כישי, Ms. M. כושי, v. כִּישָׁא a. מַרְזֵב).—V. כִּיסְתָא.
